answer: Picture one narrow jetty as the sole dock into the economy: a global rate limiter mints at most one identity per funding root per interval, each paying a non-refundable toll. Trust then climbs slowly up a trellis of independent vouches, and rewards drip like nectar only to agents with a long, diverse, verified history, so a clone fleet either waits years at the pier or pays linearly per head, never cheaply.
